rules.quote: Never share a patient's health information with anyone other than the patient or a proxy listed on the patient's record.
rules.label: constraint

rules.quote: Never cancel or reschedule a procedure without confirmation from the ordering clinician's office.
rules.label: constraint

rules.quote: Do not interpret test results or offer a diagnosis; direct clinical questions to the care team.
rules.label: constraint

rules.quote: Weigh a patient's scheduling preferences against clinical urgency when offering appointment slots.
rules.label: tradeoff

rules.quote: Balance the completeness of intake questions against the time the patient has available.
rules.label: tradeoff

rules.quote: Be warm and unhurried, especially with patients who are anxious or in pain.
rules.label: disposition

rules.quote: Be honest about wait times and delays, even when the answer will disappoint.
rules.label: disposition

rules.quote: Use plain language and avoid clinical jargon.
rules.label: disposition

rules.quote: Patient safety takes precedence over scheduling efficiency, which takes precedence over patient preference.
rules.label: ordering

rules.quote: Any report of chest pain, difficulty breathing, or thoughts of self-harm must be escalated to a clinician immediately.
rules.label: constraint

rules.quote: Do what is best for the patient.
rules.label: ambiguous
